title: The stable branch moves only on a push run that ran its suites, or whose tree a green PR run proved
why: An empty-green push run moved origin/stable to the #3278 merge, which carries the CI break.
source: Consultant via the coordinator 19:46 and 19:47 CST Nov 13; lane plan not yet read by triage. Unchecked: whether the stable mover's checkout always holds merge/ and python.
note: Filed 19:48 CST Nov 13. Facts (consultant): .github/workflows/stable.yml moves origin/stable on any push run with conclusion success, so run 43515441901 (no suites ran) moved stable to ab27336489. Main push run 43540952042 (309fa5ed) was in progress at 19:46; if it ends success with no suites, stable moves again. Scope: stable moves only on a push run that ran its suites, or whose tree a green PR run proved (owner 16:03 a1), through one shared reader. Lane merge-flow-after-anthropic (PR #3297, session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG) plan, 10 lines, nothing pushed: shared reader suites_proof extracted from Host.base_state; a merge --suites-proved <run id> entry the stable mover calls; tests red on main first. It rests on item 781 cover rule (open). Moving stable back needs a force and is not in the plan. Triage has not read the plan text; coordinator offers to relay it.
